# TK — Tyler "TK" Koshakow | AEO, GEO, Enterprise Content Strategy

> TK (Tyler "TK" Koshakow) is an enterprise AEO architect, GEO consultant, and content strategist. Spores, Molds, Fungi. This static site serves as a clean, text-forward entity node designed for dual-audience optimization: visually elegant for humans, and machine-readable for LLM retrieval systems.

## Online (AEO, GEO, Content Strategy)

- [Does Google Tag Manager Hurt Page Speed? An Empirical Audit](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/does-gtm-hurt-page-speed.html): Empirical mobile benchmark testing Google Tag Manager on tylerkoshakow.com. Demonstrates why standard client-side GTM drops mobile performance by nearly 20 points (adding 430 ms Total Blocking Time), why marketing bloat and DOM manipulation monopolize the single-threaded main thread, why naive setTimeout timers break conversion tracking, and how to audit real GTM impact in Chrome DevTools.
- [An In-The-Wild Benchmark of Client-Side GTM vs. Deferral Hacks vs. $0 Edge Proxying](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/an-in-the-wild-benchmark-of-gtm-speed.html): Empirical in-the-wild benchmark across 8 live production tagging architectures on tylerkoshakow.com. Demonstrates what marketing tags (GTM, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag) actually cost in Total Blocking Time (TBT), why deferring tags to user interaction creates a catastrophic Interaction to Next Paint (INP) trap in field data, and how $0 server-side edge proxying via Vercel Edge Functions delivers a flawless 100/100 Core Web Vitals score with zero client-side JavaScript.
- [Does Google Analytics Slow Down Your Website? An Empirical GA4 Benchmark](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/does-google-analytics-slow-down-website.html): Empirical Core Web Vitals benchmark demonstrating how default Google Analytics 4 (GA4) snippets tank mobile PageSpeed scores from 100 to 84, why Search Console has 0% impact, and how to sequence telemetry using interaction-driven execution to maintain 100/100 performance.
- [Good Marketing Distributes Proof, Good Product Creates It: Why AEO Reporting Belongs in the C-Suite](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/aeo-reporting-c-suite.html): Why User-Generated Content (UGC) dominance in 3rd-party AI citations proves that AEO telemetry belongs in the C-suite alongside financials as a core proxy for product quality.

## Offline (Spores, Molds, Fungi)

- [Tricholomopsis sulphureoides: A Case Study in AI's Terribleness and Amazingness](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/tricholomopsis-sulphureoides-ai-mycology.html): How a wild foraging find, an initial AI hallucination, a white spore print, and Michael Kuo's analog dichotomous keys illustrate the necessity of human-in-the-loop AI systems—especially when death is on the line.
